description: Read one advisory in full by id: CVE, GHSA, MAL or Patchwire id, any case, aliases resolve. Returns its ranges, fixed versions, exploit conditions with the source sentence they come from, a summary and the sources. Use it after get_advisories or list_feed gave you an id. An unknown id, or one older than 120 days, returns an error.

id.description: An advisory id: CVE (CVE-2026-12345), GHSA (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx), MAL or a Patchwire id. Any case; aliases resolve.

name: get_advisory
title: One advisory in full
